rubric.5: virtually all essential objects/scene/actions correct; no meaningful hallucination.
rubric.4: largely correct with only minor omissions or errors.
rubric.3: main scene broadly correct but notable mistake or omission.
rubric.2: partial match but major misunderstanding or hallucination.
rubric.1: very limited overlap; most essential content wrong.
rubric.0: main objects/scene wrong or description nearly unrelated.
